programs.description: Max, a bionic guinea pig, and his goldfish best friend embark on fascinating adventures after they escape the laboratory and try to fit in the wildlife.
Gon Freecss sets out to become a Hunter, an elite professional known for hunting rare monsters and treasures, in the hopes of finding his absent father.
Monkey D Luffy, a young man made of rubber, and his team of pirates embark on an exciting adventure to find a fabled treasure.
Kiteretsu, an elementary school student who uses his inventions to help people, and Korosuke, his robot, partake in various adventures along with his friends.
Three brother bears, Grizzly, Panda, and Ice, awkwardly navigate life in the San Francisco Bay Area as they try to fit into modern human society.
